scope: Same synthetic local ingress + actual image-extra trim + upload helper harness run before production edits and after final compact page storage/legacy exemptions. 50 MiB source each. Separate fresh child per mode. No gateway/DB/network/Workers/concurrency/continuous peak proof.
metrics: heapPlusExternal is heapUsed + external at each SAME sample; arrayBuffers is a subset of external, never added twice. Independent metric maxima must not be summed. GC stages can retain external allocation accounting until a later collection. No forced GC in the normal streaming loop.
